title: API Integrations
description: Learn how to integrate Tijraa with third-party services using APIs, webhooks, and integration tools.
content:
API Integrations

Integrate Tijraa with third-party services, tools, and platforms using APIs and webhooks to extend functionality and automate workflows.

API Overview

Tijraa provides RESTful APIs for:

  • Product management
  • Order processing
  • Customer management
  • Inventory updates
  • Webhook subscriptions

API Authentication

Authenticate API requests:

  • API keys
  • OAuth tokens
  • Bearer tokens
  • Secure endpoints

Common Integrations

Payment Gateways

Integrate payment processors:

  • Stripe
  • PayPal
  • Other payment gateways

Shipping Providers

Connect shipping services:

  • Shipping calculators
  • Label printing
  • Tracking integration

Email Services

Integrate email marketing:

  • Mailchimp
  • SendGrid
  • Other email services

Analytics

Connect analytics tools:

  • Google Analytics
  • Facebook Pixel
  • Other tracking tools

Webhooks

Set up webhooks for real-time updates:

  • Order created
  • Order updated
  • Payment received
  • Product updated
  • Customer created

Setting Up Integrations

Step 1: Access Integrations

Navigate to Settings → Integrations.

Step 2: Select Service

Choose the service you want to integrate.

Step 3: Configure

Enter API credentials and configure settings.

Step 4: Test

Test the integration to ensure it works correctly.

Step 5: Activate

Activate the integration.

API Documentation

Access API documentation:

  • Endpoint reference
  • Request/response formats
  • Authentication methods
  • Code examples
  • Rate limits

Best Practices

  • Keep API keys secure
  • Use webhooks for real-time updates
  • Handle errors gracefully
  • Monitor API usage
  • Test thoroughly
  • Document custom integrations
